prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1076; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Claimant reports being stopped and struck from behind while exiting a space. Claimant states they experienced a concussion and was seen at an urgent care facility the same day. No attorney listed. Claimant prefers phone contact in the afternoons.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone regarding the incident. Claimant describes headache, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating since the collision. Claimant confirmed they are not represented by counsel and is handling the claim directly. Explained the general claims process and requested medical records and the treatment plan.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles from claimant. Rear bumper damage visible on claimant's vehicle, minor scratch and dent on the other vehicle. Insured's statement obtained and consistent with claimant's account of the lot layout and direction of travel. Parking lot security footage requested from the property owner.

Entry 4: Claimant forwarded discharge paperwork from the urgent care visit diagnosing a concussion and recommending rest and follow-up with a primary care provider. Claimant reports missing several days of work and is gathering employer documentation. Advised claimant to keep receipts for all out-of-pocket medical expenses and rental costs.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant to confirm receipt of the rental vehicle authorization and to check on symptoms. Claimant reports symptoms are improving slowly and has an appointment with a neurologist scheduled. Reminded claimant that the file will remain open pending medical updates and that the adjuster will provide a written status summary once the records are reviewed.
